text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —One day, some time after Symboli Kris S's Arima Kinen had come to a close...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—That is all.
Concluding... routine report.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Good work. ...Thinking that today marks the end
of receiving your regular reports makes me feel a bit lonely.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Regarding the recent Arima Kinen...
Once again, it was a truly magnificent race."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As an Uma Musume myself,
I could feel a passionate fire ignite within me—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Even beyond today,
please allow me to quietly cheer on
your endeavors as my "trial."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"First of all—
you have served me well up to this day."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Truly... thank you, Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: The one who invited me... to Japan... was... Rudolf...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I was only... answering that call—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"And from now on... I will continue—
to fulfill—my 'mission'—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, excuse me―

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yeah. —Until next time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...The "revolution" you will bring.
The future of Japan's new racing world—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps out there, there might have even been
a race where you and I would face each other—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...No. It's too early to jump to conclusions
and say 'maybe it was.'"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The racing world in which you and I live.
Its future will continue on for a long time to come—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...By the way, do you know?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That with your track record up to today, you are suddenly being seen as someone who stands equal to—and could surpass—me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—...To produce "results"—
I have done everything in my power.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
What you feel about... the "results"
you've built up... is entirely up to you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That answer is so like you.
...And I partly agree with it—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —No matter what anyone thinks, we won't know the truth until we actually run the race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...The "revolution" you will bring.
The future of Japan's new racing world—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If there were to be a race
where you and I face off there as well—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What will you do?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――...Nothing will change.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I will—faithfully perform
my duty—as a 'trial.'"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
No matter what kind of race it is—
no matter who the opponent is—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I will...—run as myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I see—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That's Symboli Kris S for you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. Perhaps your passion rubbed off on me.
It seems I've gotten a little "heated up" myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...You have fulfilled your duties admirably up to this day.
Truly—thank you, Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I hope you will allow me to continue supporting you
from the shadows as your "trial."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: “...The one who called me... to Japan... was Rudolf...”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I was only... answering that call—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"And from now on... I will continue—
to fulfill—my 'mission'—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, excuse me―

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yeah. —Until next time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Someday, when that day comes——

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As the "Emperor",
I shall face this "trial" head-on.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That is the greatest expression of gratitude—I can offer you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I have a small suggestion, if you don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —By the way, do you know?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That with your track record up to today, you are suddenly being seen as someone who surpasses me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—...To produce "results"—
I have done everything in my power.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
What you feel about... the "results"
you've built up... is entirely up to you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That answer is so like you.
...And I partly agree with it—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —No matter what anyone thinks, we won't know the truth until we actually run the race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...The "revolution" you will bring.
The future of Japan's new racing world—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If there were to be a race
where you and I face off there as well—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What will you do?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Nothing will ever change.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I will—faithfully perform
my duty—as a 'trial.'"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
No matter what kind of race it is—
no matter who the opponent is—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I will...—run.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I see—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Then wouldn't it be amusing to take a sneak peek
at a fraction of that future right now?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —...If that is what you wish—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I...—accept the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (――Rudolf.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(I am grateful.
For bringing me here to Japan—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (That is why—if Rudolph wishes for it—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(I will—with all my heart and soul...
become the "Emperor's" "ordeal"—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
“—More often than not,
our running speaks far louder than our words.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Kris S. You have more than repaid me for everything.
Back then, and even now—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"And today, I deliberately choose...
to convey this to you not through my running, but with words."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...You have fulfilled your duties admirably up to this day.
Truly, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Next time, in a proper venue and in the proper form,
I want to face the "trial" that is you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: This is my greatest expression of gratitude to you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —It will surely become an "ordeal."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
—That's Symboli Kris S for you.
